levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The plate includes fewer than two distinct colors or food groups.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The plate includes four different colors or food groups, confirmed by the guardian.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The plate includes four different colors or food groups, and the learner explains why each item counts as different from the others.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner cannot name the color or food group of the items without help.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner names each item's color and food group out loud before eating.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner names each item's color and food group, and identifies which food group was missing from the plate that day.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner refuses to name or describe one or more of the four items, or the task is abandoned partway through.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner names and briefly describes all four items in a neutral way, regardless of whether any item is familiar or new.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner adds one specific, non-judgmental sensory or descriptive detail for each item, such as its shape, texture, or where it usually shows up in a meal.

lookFors: The guardian confirms four distinct colors or food groups were actually present, not just named.
No response applies a moral label to any food item; the language stays limited to color and food group.
Whether an item is familiar or new to the learner never raises or lowers any score in this dimension.
If the simulation alternative is used, the drawing or plan still names four distinct colors or food groups.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
